name: @activepieces/piece-smartlead
description: Powerful cold email outreach platform with multi-account rotation, email warmup, unified inbox, and advanced analytics.

auth.description:
To obtain your API key:
1. Log in to your SmartLead account
2. Go to **Profile -> Settings → API Key **
3. Copy your API key

The API key is passed as a query parameter to all API requests.

create_campaign.name: create_campaign
create_campaign.description: Create a new cold email campaign in SmartLead

name.description: Name of the campaign. Defaults to "Untitled Campaign" if not provided.

client_id.description: Associate the campaign with a specific client (for agency/white-label accounts). Leave empty to use your default.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new, empty cold email campaign in SmartLead, identified by name; on agency/white-label accounts an optional client ID associates it with a specific client. Use this as the first step before adding leads or configuring sequences. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate campaign even with the same name.

add_leads_to_campaign.name: add_leads_to_campaign
add_leads_to_campaign.description: Add one or more leads to a campaign with validation and deduplication. Maximum 400 leads per request.

campaign_id.description: The ID of the campaign to add leads to

ignore_duplicate_leads_in_other_campaign.description: Allow the same lead in multiple campaigns

aiMetadata.description: Adds leads to an existing SmartLead campaign by campaign ID, passing a JSON array where each lead requires an email field. Optional flags let you bypass the global block list, unsubscribe list, cross-campaign duplicate check, and community bounce list. Use to populate or grow a campaign recipient list; capped at 400 leads per call. Not idempotent: it appends leads on each call (though SmartLead deduplicates by email within the campaign).

get_campaign_statistics.name: get_campaign_statistics
get_campaign_statistics.description: Retrieve comprehensive analytics for a campaign including open rates, click rates, reply rates, and engagement statistics.

campaign_id.description: The ID of the campaign to get statistics for

aiMetadata.description: Fetches aggregate performance analytics for a single SmartLead campaign by campaign ID, covering open, click, and reply rates and related engagement metrics. Use to report on or evaluate how a campaign is performing. Read-only and idempotent.

update_campaign_settings.name: update_campaign_settings
update_campaign_settings.description: Update campaign settings including tracking, stop conditions, and deliverability options.

campaign_id.description: The ID of the campaign to update

stop_lead_settings.description: When to stop emailing a lead

unsubscribe_text.description: Custom unsubscribe text added to campaign emails

enable_ai_esp_matching.description: Use AI to intelligently pair leads with optimal email accounts

send_as_plain_text.description: Send emails as plain text for better deliverability with technical audiences

follow_up_percentage.description: Percentage of leads to follow up with (0-100)

aiMetadata.description: Updates configuration on an existing SmartLead campaign by campaign ID, such as open/click tracking, the stop-lead condition, unsubscribe text, AI ESP matching, plain-text sending, and follow-up percentage. Use to adjust how a campaign sends and tracks; at least one setting must be supplied and follow-up percentage must be 0-100. Idempotent: it overwrites the targeted settings, so repeating the same input leaves the campaign in the same state.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
